# Audemars Piguet

> > Swiss luxury watchmaker since 1875, renowned for haute horlogerie, the iconic Royal Oak collection, and innovative complications crafted in the Vallée de Joux.

Audemars Piguet creates exceptional timepieces including Royal Oak, Royal Oak Concept, Royal Oak Offshore, and Code 11.59 collections. The family-owned manufacture combines traditional Swiss watchmaking with contemporary art patronage through AP Contemporary, while maintaining commitments to sustainability and craftsmanship excellence.

## Key Topics

- Royal Oak
- Haute Horlogerie
- Swiss Watchmaking
- Vallée de Joux
- Royal Oak Concept
- Royal Oak Offshore
- Code 11.59
- Perpetual Calendar
- Tourbillon
- Chronograph
- Limited Edition
- AP Contemporary
- Gérald Genta
- Le Brassus
- [RE]Master Collection

## Watch Collections

- [Schweizer Luxusuhren-Kollektionen | Audemars Piguet](https://www.audemarspiguet.com/com/de/collections.html): Main collections page: Royal Oak, Code 11.59, Royal Oak Offshore & Concept
- [Wir stellen vor: die ikonische Royal Oak](https://www.audemarspiguet.com/com/de/collections/royal-oak-collection.html): Iconic Royal Oak collection since 1972, designed by Gérald Genta
- [Royal Oak Concept Kollektion | Entdecken Sie neue Hightech-Horizonte](https://www.audemarspiguet.com/com/de/collections/royal-oak-concept-collection.html): Royal Oak Concept: high-tech materials with innovative complications
- [Audemars Piguet | [RE]Master](https://www.audemarspiguet.com/com/de/collections/remaster-collection.html): [RE]Master collection reinterpreting vintage AP designs with modern codes
